f: Dubai International has been the world's busiest airport for international passengers since 2014.
The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi can hold more than 40,000 worshippers.

Khasab is in Musandam, an Omani exclave cut off from the rest of Oman by the UAE.

Kish is a free trade zone island in the Persian Gulf.

Batumi is a Black Sea resort city with a subtropical climate.
Sukhumi is the capital of Abkhazia, a breakaway region recognized by Russia but not by most countries.

The Pharos lighthouse of Alexandria was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

Hurghada is a Red Sea resort town known for diving and snorkeling.
The Valley of the Kings lies across the Nile from Luxor.
The Aswan High Dam created Lake Nasser, one of the largest reservoirs in the world.

Tripoli's Red Castle overlooks the harbor and dates back centuries.
Benghazi began as the Greek colony of Euesperides.
Kufra is a group of Saharan oases in southeastern Libya.

Djerba is the largest island in North Africa.
The Casbah of Algiers is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Oran is the birthplace of raï music.

Tindouf is home to large camps of Sahrawi refugees.

Nouakchott lies on the Atlantic coast at the edge of the Sahara.
Dakar sits on the Cap-Vert peninsula, the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

The Bijagos archipelago lies just off the coast of Guinea-Bissau.

Lomé lies directly on the border with Ghana.
The stilt village of Ganvié stands on a lagoon near Cotonou.
Lagos was Nigeria's capital until 1991.

Port Harcourt is a hub of Nigeria's oil industry in the Niger Delta.
Kano is the largest city in northern Nigeria and has a walled old city.
Niamey sits on the Niger River.

Bamako lies on the Niger River.

Ouagadougou hosts FESPACO, Africa's largest film festival.

Khartoum is where the Blue Nile and White Nile meet.
South Sudan became independent in 2011.
Asmara's modernist Italian-era architecture is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Djibouti hosts foreign military bases from several countries, including the US and China.
Mogadishu has been a key Indian Ocean port for centuries.

Nairobi National Park borders the city, with lions living within sight of skyscrapers.
Mombasa is East Africa's busiest seaport region and Kenya's main port.
Lamu Old Town is a UNESCO site on an island with almost no cars.
Uganda's main airport at Entebbe sits on the shore of Lake Victoria.
Rwanda banned plastic bags in 2008.
Bujumbura sits on the northeastern shore of Lake Tanganyika.
The name Dar es Salaam means haven of peace in Arabic.
Freddie Mercury was born in Zanzibar.
Douala is Cameroon's largest city and main port.
Yaoundé is the capital of Cameroon, not Douala.
Bangui lies on the Ubangi River, which forms the border with the DR Congo.
Libreville was founded in 1849 as a settlement for freed slaves.
Malabo is on Bioko Island, not on the mainland part of Equatorial Guinea.
The equator passes through Ilhéu das Rolas, a small islet off São Tomé.

Lubumbashi is the center of the Congolese copper mining belt.
Goma lies beside the Nyiragongo volcano, whose 2002 eruption sent lava through the city.
Luanda is Angola's capital and a major oil-industry city.
Lusaka is one of the fastest-growing cities in southern Africa.
Livingstone is the Zambian gateway to Victoria Falls.

Maputo was called Lourenço Marques until 1976.
Gaborone lies close to the South African border.
Maun is the gateway to the Okavango Delta.
Windhoek is one of the least densely populated capital regions in the world.
Walvis Bay is Namibia's main port, beside the Namib Desert.

Table Mountain overlooks Cape Town.
Durban has the busiest container port in Africa south of the equator.
Lesotho is entirely surrounded by South Africa.
eSwatini is one of the last absolute monarchies in Africa.
Antananarivo sits on hills in Madagascar's central highlands.
Nosy Be is Madagascar's main island resort destination.
The dodo, now extinct, once lived only on Mauritius.

Karthala, an active volcano, dominates Grande Comore island where Moroni stands.

Praia lies on Santiago, the largest island of Cabo Verde.
